hectic = full of busy, rushed activity
leisurely = done slowly, without rushing
night owl = a person who prefers to stay up late
early bird = a person who likes to get up and start early
household budget = a plan for how a household will spend its money
share the chores = to divide housework fairly among the people who live together
put things off = to delay tasks you ought to do
financially independent = able to pay for your own life without help from parents
move out = to leave your parents' home and live elsewhere
housemate = a person who shares a rented house with you
spare room = an extra bedroom used for visitors or a tenant
personal space = the physical and emotional room you need around yourself
privacy = the state of not being watched or interrupted
nosy = too interested in other people's private lives
overprotective = trying too hard to keep someone from any risk or independence
lenient = not strict; allowing more freedom than usual
rebellious = resisting rules and authority, especially as a teenager
adolescent = a young person between childhood and adulthood; typical of that age
curfew = a time by which you must be home in the evening
nag = to keep complaining or reminding someone in an annoying way
